# Rule 2- No Sexual Content
[bold]This is a 16+ server[/bold]. Erotic and explicit sexual content is strictly prohibited in all forms and mediums. This includes any erotic roleplay (ERP) or depictions of erotic content via text, imagery, or any other form of content.
## Erotic Roleplay [bold]ERP is forbidden[/bold]. This is not a loose rule! Any erotic roleplay will result in an immediate ban.
This is not a ban on romantic roleplay, relationships, or general social interactions that may be seen as crude. You are allowed to have partners, reference families, use crass humor, and the like. The sole intent of this rule is to ban any and all roleplay of an explicitly sexual nature.
## Consent And Player Comfort There will be edge cases allowed or not disallowed by these rules which nonetheless result in other players being uncomfortable. Romantic, flirtatious, and obscene behavior is only permitted because we trust you to be mature. Do not waste that trust.
OOC concerns take precedent over IC logic in the case of player consent. It doesn't matter if your character would flirt or make dirty jokes– If you are asked OOC to stop, [bold]you must stop immediately[/bold]. This applies across all rules, but is especially important here.
## Acceptable Language Insults are not considered erotic or sexual, as long as they do not become excessive or extreme. Crass jokes likewise are not banned as long as they are used in moderation and kept to a reasonable level. However, you should never intentionally use explicit language outside of interjections and insults.
Sexuality is a fact of existence and its diversity is something to be celebrated. However, it is not the focus of this game. Your character is an adult in a workplace environment– what wouldn't be acceptable in an office is unlikely to be acceptable here.
